plate_comment: If no fueling state is selected (FUELING_STATE_NOT_SELECTED) and all_speed_governor_application_override_mode (e2m 1170 +C ASG_As_Override_Mode) is set: selects FUELING_STATE_ALL_SPEED_GOVERNOR_APPLICATION (30; e2m label ASG_APPL) and loads the application-specific all speed governor set (e2m 1170 +C..+3C: reference and feedback speed - droop / proportional / integral / derivative gains - filter coefficients - fueling limits - reset states) into the working governor selection. Nothing in this build writes that record (RAM - zero at every start) so the mode never engages. Nothing is restored (was cm848_restoreEngineOperatingMode)
